title: Client & Business Intelligence Analyst (Hybrid)
description:
About the Company
A leading business law firm with a strong reputation for handling complex transactions and litigation, supported by a national and international platform.

About the Role
We are seeking a Client & Business Intelligence Analyst for the Toronto office. This role supports business development through market research, competitive intelligence, and data analysis, delivering insights that inform strategy, client development, and RFPs.

The Offer
Salary of $70,000 to $95,000, plus benefits including one day of work from home, three weeks’ vacation, and a group RRSP, among others. This is an opportunity to join a high-performing professional environment focused on strategic business intelligence and client development, with exposure to advanced research tools and firm-wide initiatives.

What You Bring
You have 3+ years of experience in research, analytics, or business intelligence, along with a relevant post-secondary degree. You bring strong Excel and PowerPoint skills, and familiarity with tools such as Bloomberg, Capital IQ, or PitchBook is an asset. You are analytical, detail-oriented, and organized, with the ability to manage competing priorities while working independently and collaboratively. Strong communication skills and a curious, proactive mindset are essential.

Next Steps
If you are interested in learning more about this opportunity, please apply, in confidence. Thank you for your interest in the position and in Forge Recruitment.
